articles.title: Apple and LG team up on new smart home gear, starting with a lock, doorbell, and thermostat
articles.essence: Apple is collaborating with LG on a new lineup of smart home devices, including a video doorbell, thermostat, indoor camera, and more, according to a report from Bloomberg. The products will reportedly feature LG branding but integrate with the company's rumored smart home hub that's expected to launch during an event on October 13th.

articles.title: Tesla’s Model 3 and Model Y can be a backup battery for your house
articles.essence: Some Tesla Model 3 and Model Y owners can use their EV battery to keep the lights on longer during a power outage, now that Tesla's expanding the Powershare Home Backup feature. It was previously only available on the Cybertruck, and also requires owning Tesla's Powerwall 3.
